# Rollout plan {#sec-plan}

A five-phase path to take a project from "everything in my head" to "ready for a collaborator and paying customers". Each phase fits in one or two iterations and doesn't depend on paid tools.

## Phase 0 — Right away

- [ ] Move every secret into a password manager, in a project vault.
- [ ] Check whether any secret has ever been committed; if so, change it.
- [ ] Turn on 2FA, secret scanning, and push protection on GitHub.
- [ ] Move changing binaries (presentations, videos) out of the repository and into the drive.

## Phase 1 — Organize the work

- [ ] Create the GitHub Project with Status, Priority, Area, Estimate, and Iteration (Chapter [-@sec-projects]).
- [ ] Create the labels and the Backlog, Current iteration, and Roadmap views.
- [ ] Move `TODO.md` into issues and drafts; archive the file.
- [ ] Create the current epics as issues of type Epic.
- [ ] Run the first iteration with planning and review (Chapter [-@sec-agile]).

## Phase 2 — Code flow and CI

- [ ] Write `HOW-WE-WORK.md` and the root `README.md` (Chapter [-@sec-docs]).
- [ ] Create `.github/` with PR and issue templates and `dependabot.yml`.
- [ ] Create the minimal CI: lint, tests, and migration check (Chapter [-@sec-cicd]).
- [ ] Turn on branch protection for `main` (Chapter [-@sec-flow]).
- [ ] Adopt Conventional Commits and start a `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Phase 3 — Operations

- [ ] Set up error tracking on the backend and the frontend (Chapter [-@sec-observability]).
- [ ] Set up an external uptime monitor, with alerts.
- [ ] Define RPO and RTO; do the first test restore (Chapter [-@sec-backups]).
- [ ] Write the deploy, rollback, and secret-rotation runbooks.
- [ ] Create `docs/postmortems/` and the template (Chapter [-@sec-incidents]).
- [ ] Have a staging environment with fictional data.

## Phase 4 — Ready for a collaborator and paying customers

- [ ] A README with "run it in 10 minutes" and seed data (Chapter [-@sec-people]).
- [ ] `CONTRIBUTING.md` and three `good first issue` issues.
- [ ] Onboarding and offboarding checklists for collaborators.
- [ ] Audit log and masking of sensitive data (Chapter [-@sec-security]).
- [ ] Privacy and data retention policy.
- [ ] Automated deploy from `main`, with feature flags (Chapter [-@sec-migrations]).
- [ ] Status page.
